subject.title: [Feature]: Add channels.signal.linkPreview config and pass-through to signal-cli JSON-RPC send

question: Should Signal link-preview support be added now, and if so what default, per-account scope, primary-device failure behavior, and metadata boundary should `channels.signal.linkPreview` use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but defaults, `updateConfiguration` timing, linked-device/container behavior, and untrusted URL metadata handling are product/security choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add explicit safe pass-through
options.body: Add a default-safe Signal plugin setting that passes only caller-provided preview fields, covers native and container modes, and documents primary-device limits.

options.title: Defer behind preview security design
options.body: Keep this open until the related URL-preview prompt-injection issue defines whether OpenClaw may fetch or inject preview metadata.

options.title: Enable default-on previews
options.body: Turn previews on by default while preserving an escape hatch, accepting a larger upgrade and security review burden.

recommendation.title: Add explicit safe pass-through
recommendation.body: Add a default-safe Signal plugin setting that passes only caller-provided preview fields, covers native and container modes, and documents primary-device limits.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent Signal send/container history and has already provided public implementation context on this issue.
